_comment: Divergences between a Drive filename date and lenders.json that have been looked at and settled. `scan` prints these as `ack` instead of STALE so the monthly report only shows things nobody has judged yet. Remove an entry when a new PDF arrives for that lender -- the question reopens. td and dfc were removed on 2026-08-26 once their Drive files were renamed to match the dates printed inside the documents — the divergence no longer exists.

gls.reason: App stores a version string '2026 (v53)', not a date. The PDF is dated 2026-07-27. Needs a real date eventually.
